scope: Internal model-development interpretation of registered complete cold seed/pressure cohorts.
interpretation: Prism-associated central-core lag survives the tested seeds and pressures at named matched stages. Same-age gaps differ with growth stage; neither seed independence nor universal pressure clock rescaling follows.
followupPriority: Use existing saved fields/captures to inspect tip-versus-core filling before a new cold parameter sweep. If quantitative pressure timing is prioritized, a four-case CFL.0125 test at pressure50662.5/202650 with neither/prism-only can challenge the pressure interaction against existing .025 controls. Not selected or launched.
limits: Two complete12-member cohorts share the same4 normal-seed/normal-pressure reference rows;20 unique rows in total.
Stage comparisons use each row own entry plus a common elapsed plateau duration, not equal absolute age or normalized individual plateau fraction.
All gaps are central-plane lattice-radius measures; occupied sites are not deposited mass.
Seed changes alter volume, surface and transport together; no isolated geometry cause.
Pressure comparisons do not establish universal clock rescaling, physical validation, grid convergence or domain independence.
Seed tip9 cohort unavailable because one basal-only thick-seed trajectory lacks an observed plateau exit. No reduced cohort or terminal substitute.
Saved-state/field mechanism inference, full suite, new simulations and NAS publication are outside this analysis.
